# MeloTTS Japanese official acoustic-core fixture

This fixture uses `myshell-ai/MeloTTS-Japanese` at revision
`367f8795464b531b4e97c1515bddfc1243e60891`. Its `manifest.json` pins the
checkpoint and every generated file. See
[`../melotts_english/README.md`](../melotts_english/README.md) for the shared
independent-oracle contract, public GGUF ledger, regeneration command, and
scope boundary excluding raw-text normalization, G2P, and BERT tokenization.
